description: Header file defining the FFMPEG-based VideoDecoder implementation class for the starboard project, including class declaration, methods, and internal state.

classes.name: VideoDecoderImpl<FFMPEG>
classes.description: Implementation of a video decoder using FFMPEG, supporting initialization, decoding, buffer management, and thread handling.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new VideoDecoder instance.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the decoder instance is valid.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: AllocateBuffer
methods.description: Allocates buffers for decoding, with version depending on LIBAVUTIL_VERSION_INT.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decode target for rendering.

methods.name: UpdateDecodeTarget_Locked
methods.description: Updates the decode target with a new frame, thread-safe.

methods.name: ProcessDecodedFrame
methods.description: Processes a decoded FFmpeg frame, passing it to the callback.

methods.name: ThreadEntryPoint
methods.description: Entry point for the decoder thread.

methods.name: DecoderThreadFunc
methods.description: Main function for the decoder thread loop.
